questions.question: Analyze the impact of mobile journalism on traditional news media.
questions.solution_html:
• Mobilejournalismhas significantly impacted traditional news mediabyshifting
  • thefocus toreal-time, on-the-go reporting. With smartphones enabling journalists
  • to capture, edit, andshare content instantly, news cycles have become faster
  • challenging traditional media’s reliance onlengthy production processes. It has
  • also democratized news creation, allowing citizenjournalists to contribute, while
  • encouraging established outlets to adopt mobile-first strategies. This shifthas led
  • to moreaccessible, diverse, and immediatenews coverage, but italso poses
  • challenges to traditionalmedia in terms ofcredibility, quality control, and
  • monetizationmodels.
